title: Test the real Check aggregator step against red and green job results
body:
Outcome: test/workflow.test.ts executes the `check` job's run block from .github/workflows/ci.yml against needs fixtures instead of pinning its text.
Evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:142-167 is the only required merge signal; test/workflow.test.ts:94-103 matches its text with regexes, and three mutants (always exit 0, never count failures, ignore needs) pass every current assertion (probe /mnt/storage/tmp/krn/research/check-mutation.mjs).
Source: finding CI2 in .krn/runs/lead/t3code-agentic/lanes/t3-ci-scripts.md (t3code extracts the real run text of a named workflow step and runs it with stub shell functions).
Acceptance: a fixture matrix of at least 7 needs combinations (all success; test skipped by the change filter; test skipped while the filter said run; lint failure; changes failure; cancelled; missing key) passes on the current script, and each of the three mutants fails at least one case.
